dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (日医標準レセプトソフト), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux; uses COPY statements for screen/SPA areas, /var/tmp/ file paths, no COMP-3

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical receipt (レセプト) processing system - ORCA (JMA standard receipt software); this component handles medical treatment act (診療行為) confirmation/entry screen K08
purpose.summary: ORCGK08 is a batch/interactive program within the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that handles the diagnosis/treatment act input and confirmation screen (診療行為確認 K08). It manages treatment item tables, insurance point calculations, screen paging, and various medical billing categories. The program has an extensive revision history from 2001 to 2014 covering additions for hospitalization, self-pay, group diagnosis, and insurance combinations.

notable_features: 66 COPY statements for modular screen/SPA areas
500 PERFORM statements indicating structured procedural logic
REDEFINES used extensively for multi-format data areas
Japanese EUC-encoded comments (latin-1 decoded as mojibake)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
verdict.notes: File decoded as latin-1 but comments are actually Japanese EUC-JP encoding, appearing as mojibake. This is definitively part of the open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system. Source truncated at 16000 chars but structure is clear from indicators. The program name ORCGK08 follows ORCA naming conventions (GK=診療行為 treatment acts, 08=screen number).
